skip_reason_text.empty-annex-i: Annex I title followed directly by Annex II (the decision did not change the SmPC)
skip_reason_text.no-annex-i: the annex holds only Annex II or III (the decision did not change the SmPC)
skip_reason_text.no-smpc: Annex I has no section 1 (for example the scientific conclusions of a referral)
skip_reason_text.no-text-layer: no usable text layer (no OCR is done)
skip_reason_text.unreadable-pdf: PyMuPDF could not open the PDF
skip_reason_text.unusable-text-layer: text layer without a usable character map (no OCR is done)
